items.title: Home Cinema Streaming Platform
items.summary: HLS streaming platform with authentication and Vimeo integration.
items.description: Full-featured home cinema streaming platform with HLS video playback, user authentication, subscription gating, and Vimeo integration. Built around a clean playback surface with adaptive bitrate handling.

items.title: Gaming Platform
items.summary: Modern gaming platform with a Next.js front-end and NestJS services.
items.description: Prototype gaming platform combining a Next.js front-end with a NestJS backend. Game catalog, session handling, and a modular service architecture designed for adding new titles without ceremony.

items.title: Chicken Road Crash Game
items.summary: Crash-style game built in Cocos Creator with a real-time NestJS backend.
items.description: Crash-style arcade game built in Cocos Creator with a real-time NestJS backend for multiplayer logic, server-authoritative game state, and deterministic outcomes.

items.title: Treasure Hunt Crash Game
items.summary: Treasure-themed crash game with animated gameplay and server-side state.
items.description: Treasure-themed crash game with animated gameplay and server-side game state management. Session lifecycle, animations, and payout logic kept authoritative on the NestJS service.

items.title: Lottery Scratch Game
items.summary: Interactive scratch card lottery with Cocos animations and server result handling.
items.description: Interactive scratch card lottery game with tactile Cocos Creator animations and a NestJS result-handling service. Outcomes are generated and validated server-side.

items.title: HLS Video Player
items.summary: Custom HLS player in Next.js supporting M3U8 streams with adaptive bitrate.
items.description: Custom HLS video player built in Next.js supporting M3U8 streams with adaptive bitrate playback, quality selection, and a stripped-back player chrome designed to stay out of the way.

items.title: Three.js Interactive Globe
items.summary: Explorable 3D globe rendered entirely in the browser.
items.description: Interactive 3D globe built with Three.js — explorable, animated, and fully rendered in the browser. Shader-driven atmosphere, point data overlays, and lightweight interaction model.
